query:
INSERT INTO article_votes (articleId, reaction, visitorId, createdAt) 
SELECT a.id, 'thumbsdown', CONCAT('seed_', a.id, '_td_', n.num), NOW() - INTERVAL FLOOR(RAND() * 30) DAY
FROM articles a
CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 as num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10) n;
